text.tspan: "Pipeline can't connect to GitLab": runner → network → auth, in that order
First read the exact error: no jobs picked up? "Could not resolve host"? "Connection timed out"? "SSL certificate problem"?
"HTTP Basic: Access denied" / 403? Each one points to a different layer.
tags match the job? token valid?
gitlab-runner verify · journalctl -u gitlab-runner · gitlab-runner --debug run
